sample_unit: first-response LLM outputs scored by physician panels

links.outcome: Multidimensional expert scores of RAG model versus baseline DeepSeek R1
links.effect: HPHME-Xplus-RAG median 8.00 (IQR 7.88-8.00) vs baseline median 7.63 (IQR 7.38-7.88); P<.001, r_rb=0.68, large effect
links.quote: The deployed retrieval-augmented model integrating the authoritative textbooks and the optimal LLM DeepSeek R1, HPHME-Xplus-RAG, achieved remarkable improvement in multidimensional scores compared to baseline DeepSeek R1 (median 8.00 [IQR 7.88-8.00] vs median 7.63 [IQR 7.38-7.88]; P<.001, r_rb=0.68, indicating a large effect).

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the addition of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) using authoritative textbooks to an existing LLM (DeepSeek R1), comparing performance with and without RAG on medical education questions.
